title: Spaceship Sorter (operator<=>)
hints: Date: delete the two placeholder operators and write ONE line: auto operator<=>(const Date&) const = default; It compares members in declaration order and also gives you ==.
relation: auto c = a <=> b; then test c < 0, c > 0, or c == 0 (comparison categories compare against the literal 0).

CaseInsensitive: compare character by character on std::tolower values; return the first non-equal result, then compare the lengths. `x <=> y` on two ints gives std::strong_ordering, which converts to std::weak_ordering.
A hand-written operator<=> does NOT generate operator==. Write it too: return (*this <=> other) == 0;
